notes.title: Absolute Tennis Manager Update #4
notes.content:
* Improved player fatigue during games (relative to last point duration and initial fitness)
* Minor corrections 
* Added 2 SQL related DLLs

notes.title: ATM Update #3
notes.content:
* Stability bugs fixed
* Archive menu: player countries were not correctly translated
* Archives menu, Country tab: selecting a country had a display problem
* Player Card, Rankings: the problem of displaying years has been fixed
* Achievements: some achivements were not corretly translated

notes.title: ATM Update #2
notes.content:
* In rare cases, it was possible that the game crashed during a game re-display, preventing the player from continuing his career
* Player Card, Rankings tab: the years display has been corrected
* On the games screen, the number of career points was poorly populated
* Slight increase in CPU player rest each night
* Slight decrease in the influence of fitness in matches

notes.title: Absolute Tennis Manager Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here is an update of Absolute Tennis Manager, which fixes some bugs that have been reported:
* Editor: Changing a player in the editor (including editing the real name) could in some cases result in a doubling of the same player. Fixed.
* Negotiations: During a negotiation with a staff, when you propose a counter-offer on one of the options, these were poorly taken into account after the final agreement. Fixed.
* Prize Money display: The Prize Money was not correctly displayed on your player’s card as well as on your game’s presentation screen. Fixed.
